C0120.title: Douyin Platform Crackdown on Pornographic Gambling Referral, Proxy Reporting, and Fake Traffic Leads to Arrest of 162 Suspects
C0120.summary: A Douyin platform announcement stated that it cooperated with authorities to crack down on online black-gray-market gangs, leading to the arrest of 162 suspects. The reported behaviors included pornography and gambling traffic diversion, proxy reporting, and fake traffic generation on Douyin, showing the continuing adversarial pressure short-video platforms face in content diversion, account abuse, and fake interaction governance.
